abilities.name: Explosive Fury
abilities.text: When making attacks with grenades, you gain +Rank bonus extra damage to successful attacks. When placing explosives, you may make a DN 3 Tech Test, and add +Rank bonus to both Damage and AP to the attack. [GM] "+Rank bonus extra damage" is read as +Rank ED.

abilities.name: Defender of Humanity
abilities.text: Add +Rank Icons to any successful attack against a Mob.

abilities.name: Honour the Chapter (Primaris)
abilities.text: You are subject to the orders of your chapter master, and must honour the beliefs and traditions of your chapter. Your Resolve increases by +1. As a Primaris, you gain +3 Wounds.

abilities.name: Space Marine Implants
abilities.text: You are immune to the Bleeding Condition. You gain +1 bonus dice to any test related to one of the 22 implants (p.75) if the GM agrees it is appropriate.

abilities.name: Tactical Versatility (Ultramarines)
abilities.text: Exemplars of the Codex Astartes, the Ultramarines wage war with the utmost flexibility, able to turn any situation to their advantage. You may Shift for Glory twice as part of a Test. The Chapter trait, not the Tactical Space Marine's archetype ability of the same name (Core p.113).

abilities.name: Pride of Ultramar (Tradition)
abilities.text: The Imperium looks to the Ultramarines as paragons of the virtues of Astartes, and each strives to excel that reputation; strong in body, but restrained in mind, a tactical and clear-headed protector of Humanity. You start each session with 1 Wrath Point instead of 2. A Tradition, not Gene-seed, so it applies to a Primaris: Wrath 1 at the start of each session.

abilities.name: Background
abilities.text: Origin Cunning (+1 Determination); Accomplishment Cleanse and Purge (+1 Max Shock); Goal Vengeance (+1 Determination). Determination is 7 (T 5 + 2).

talents.name: Codex Innovator
talents.text: When executing a strategic plan or tactic that you helped create, you add + (Rank) dice to all Leadership (Wil) and Persuasion (Fel) Tests to guide others through the details. In addition, if you have at least one hour to plan for an upcoming encounter or mission, you receive one bonus Wrath point that can only be spent on a Narrative Declaration (Core p.164) relevant to your plan. This Wrath point can carry over between sessions, but you may never possess more than one bonus Wrath point from this Talent.

talents.name: Bolter Discipline
talents.text: When you use a weapon with the BOLT Keyword, it gains the Rapid Fire (2) Trait. If the weapon already has the Rapid Fire Trait, add +Rank to the weapon's Rapid Fire rating.

talents.name: Silent
talents.text: You can move at full Speed when Moving Stealthily (p.182). Whenever your Stealth Score would be reduced, reduce it by 1 fewer.

weapons.name: Smoke Grenade
traits: Deployed smoke in a Blast (6) area: +3 DN to BS and Awareness, +2 DN to melee (Core p.191) until the GM says it clears

gear: Omni-Scrambler (VoA p.75): +3 bonus dice to Tech (Int) or Intimidate (Wil) Tests to disrupt enemy communications within 500 metres
Divinator-class Auspex (Auspex, Core p.236): Combat Action to detect energy emissions, motion, and other life signs within 50 metres
Transpectral Combat Visor (Preysense Goggles, Core p.239): ignore any penalties to Tests due to visual conditions (also his own smoke)
Dragonfire Bolt rounds (Spread; ignores Defence bonuses from cover, Core p.230; BOLT weapons only)

detail.personality: Counts every enemy transmission and files it by Codex signal doctrine. A war is won when the enemy stops talking.

objectives.text: Chapter: silence the Kommandos' comms before the killing starts.
Secret: find out who else has been transmitting from Volkus.
